content: The test image shows a corn ear/tassel area with bulging white/pale galls emerging from dark tangled mass. This strongly suggests smut disease. Let me compare Common_smut and Head_smut references.

- **White/pale blue-white rounded galls** — characteristic immature smut galls before they turn black
- **Dark fibrous surrounding tissue** — corn silk/husk displaced by the expanding gall
- **Location at ear** — very common site for Common_smut infection
- The gall morphology exactly matches the bottom-left panel of the Common_smut reference
